The bidders who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total value. The available bid capacity is calculated as under Assessed available Bid capacity AxNx2.5-B

To qualify for award of the respective contract each tenderer in his name should have required bid capacity. To calculate Bid capacity, it will require financial turnover in last five years period i.e from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
